text: BiTRONICS 70 Series - Legacy | GE Vernova | Electrification

The BiTRONICS 70 Series Measurement System is an efficient, cost-effective substation automation solution for real-time monitoring and event recording. The BiTRONICS 70 Series Measurement System is a substation automation solution designed to satisfy AC network operators’ needs for real-time monitoring and event tracking. It is also an ideal system to help them protect their investments.

text: The BiTRONICS 70 Series consists of four component types – monitoring and recording IEDs, detached displays, firmware and software.
heading: Four main components

text: All of the BiTRONICS 70 Series IEDs use a common firmware, therefore they have the same functionality, the only difference is the hardware variant selected (M571, M572, M871 or M872).
heading: Common Firmware

text: Improved operational security and reduced costs

The BiTRONICS 70 Series Measurement System enables pre-empting catastrophic events, and improves operational security. Other benefits include reduced investigative expenses, automation investments and life-cycle costs.
heading: Improved operational security and reduced costs

text: The BiTRONICS 70 Series Measurement System can communicate using IEC61850.
